mcp.note: The repository MCP server runs locally over stdio. Brali does not currently operate a hosted remote MCP endpoint; consumers that require remote MCP must deploy the server themselves.

runtimes.title: Cursor
runtimes.note: Point Cursor at the local Brali MCP server after building the repository and installing the MCP package dependencies.

runtimes.title: Claude Code
runtimes.note: Register the local Brali MCP server with Claude Code. The example uses user scope so Brali can be reused across projects.

runtimes.title: OpenAI API
runtimes.configuration: Brali API prefetch -> bounded context packet -> Responses API
runtimes.note: Use Brali's hosted static API directly. OpenAI remote MCP requires a remotely reachable MCP server URL, which Brali does not currently host.

adoption_checklist: Choose hosted static API or local stdio MCP; do not assume Brali provides hosted remote MCP.
Try the zero-install Query Playground before writing custom integration code; copy its agent context or JSON packet to inspect the contract.
Run a reference demo before integrating your own retrieval flow.
Use reviewed/practical records for normal trusted recommendations.
Preserve canonical IDs, Brali record URLs, evidence state, and reviewed-source boundaries.
Return no trusted answer rather than silently falling back to pending-review or restricted material.
For reproducible work, pin a data-v release instead of following main.
Follow CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 attribution/share-alike terms for public non-commercial use; request separate permission for commercial use.
Share integration feedback or partnership proposals through the Brali partnerships page.
